name: Workspace Tools
description: Read-only agent tools and workflow nodes for the open project: list a folder, read a text file, and regex-search text files. Paths are confined to the active project root; desktop only.
author: cognia-next

browser.reason: Reads the open project's files through the desktop host; a browser tab has no project filesystem.

mobile.reason: The mobile shell has no open project folder to read; its filesystem is limited to app-scoped storage.

en.manifest.name: Workspace Tools
en.manifest.description: Read-only agent tools and workflow nodes for the open project: list a folder, read a text file, and regex-search text files. Paths are confined to the active project root; desktop only.
en.workflow.nodes.action.listFiles.label: List workspace files
en.workflow.nodes.action.listFiles.descript: List immediate children of a workspace directory.
en.workflow.nodes.action.readFile.label: Read workspace file
en.workflow.nodes.action.readFile.descripti: Read a UTF-8 text file from the workspace.
en.workflow.nodes.action.search.label: Search workspace
en.workflow.nodes.action.search.description: Search workspace files for a regular-expression pattern.

zh-CN.manifest.name: 工作区工具

zh-CN.workflow.nodes.action.listFiles.label: 列出工作区文件

zh-CN.workflow.nodes.action.search.label: 搜索工作区
